newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Datum raised to strong buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Datum raised to strong buy.

text.p: Hambrecht & Quist LLC said it upgraded Datum Inc to strong buy from buy, saying that "significant upside to our June quarter estimate is extremely likely."
-- forecasts earnings of $0.25 a share on revenue of $29.9 million for the June quarter.
-- said demand from customers Lucent Technologies Inc and Motorola Inc "appears robust."
-- said visibility for September quarter is quickly developing and there exists a "strong possibility" for upside to estimates of $0.27 a share on revenues of $31.4 million for the September quarter.
-- Datum shares were up three points at 29-3/4 at mid-morning.
